title: Retry artifact and CI/CD lookup requests
summary: AL-Go now retries failed artifact listing, workflow-run and build-job lookup requests, making three attempts with 5 and 10 second waits, to reduce transient failures during release and CI/CD baseline discovery. Exhausted failures still propagate.
key_points: Artifact listing requests in DetermineArtifactsForRelease and GetArtifacts now retry up to 3 times
Workflow metadata, artifact listings, and CI/CD baseline discovery requests include retry logic
Retries apply to individual failed requests with 5-second and 10-second waits between attempts
Exhausted request failures still propagate; persistent endpoint issues remain unresolved
Existing tests updated to expect three requests and two waits
